description: TiltEQ: the Eagan Matrix tilt equaliser — one control tipping the balance between bass and treble around a chosen frequency

params.text: Tips the balance between low and high, 0 to 127, and is flat at 64
Sets the frequency the tilt turns about, from 120Hz at 0% to 15kHz at 100%
Sets how much of the equalised signal is heard, from dry at 0% to wet at 100%
Switches the knob beside it between absolute and relative control voltage: absolute makes a patched cable set the value on its own, relative adds the cable to the knob

inputs.text: Sets the tilt from a cable, 0V to 10V on its own or added to the knob when its relative button is on
Sets the frequency from a cable, 0V to 10V on its own or added to the knob when its relative button is on
Sets the mix from a cable, 0V to 10V on its own or added to the knob when its relative button is on

notes: this module does nothing on its own: it needs an HC-1 in the patch, which it finds by itself, so it can be placed anywhere in the rack rather than beside it
the light at the top is lit whenever the mix is above zero

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the knob beside it.
